Replaced its premature use by direct covariant contractions g(N,.)=-dt off-axis and at the axes, proving g(N,N)=-D/(Sigma Delta)<0 before applying either musical or inverse-smoothness supplier. The coframe determinant and axis block prove the unchanged signature claim; no stronger Choice assumption is used.
